notes: *inward* is treated as a rule 30 fusion of preposition, article and adjective; the competing reading would align *inward* to the adjective alone and mark the preposition and article unrepresented. The unit's note records it.
The verse's two supplied copulas both sit on prepositional predicates (לִפְנֵי and לַצָּפוֹן) under rule 49.
